senses.en: to hold someone's attention completely
senses.pattern: be absorbed in a book / be completely absorbed in / absorb sb's attention
senses.example: The puzzle so [[absorbed]] the children that they did not notice their mother come home.
senses.example_zh: 那個拼圖讓孩子們全神貫注，連媽媽回到家都沒發現。

senses.en: to cope with costs, losses, or shocks
senses.pattern: absorb the cost / absorb losses / absorb the shock
senses.example: Small shops cannot [[absorb]] rising rents for long, so many have already raised their prices.
senses.example_zh: 小店無法長期承受不斷上漲的租金，所以許多店家已經調漲價格。

senses.en: sudden fear or worry about danger
senses.pattern: cause alarm / in alarm / with growing alarm
senses.example: The sudden rise in fever cases has caused [[alarm]] among parents across the city.
senses.example_zh: 發燒病例突然增加，已在全市家長之間引起驚慌。

senses.en: to make someone anxious or afraid
senses.pattern: alarm the public / be alarmed at / be alarmed by the news
senses.example: I don't want to [[alarm]] you, but there is smoke coming from your kitchen window.
senses.example_zh: 我不想讓你驚慌，但是你家廚房的窗戶正在冒煙。

gsat.sentence: When they saw the room they were a bit [[alarmed]], for it was laid out as a studio.

senses.en: a person you work or do business with
senses.pattern: a business associate / a close associate / a former associate
senses.example: The detective interviewed several business [[associates]] of the missing banker, but none had seen him lately.
senses.example_zh: 警探約談了失蹤銀行家的幾位生意夥伴，但最近都沒有人見過他。
senses.note: 名詞字尾讀作 /ɪt/；associate professor 副教授

senses.en: to spend time with someone
senses.pattern: associate with / refuse to associate with / associate freely with
senses.example: His parents warned him not to [[associate]] with classmates who often skipped school.
senses.example_zh: 他的父母告誡他，不要和經常蹺課的同學來往。

senses.en: to have or show a name, mark, or feature
senses.pattern: bear a name / bear a mark / bear a signature / bear a resemblance to
senses.example: The old letter [[bore]] the signature of a famous poet, which made it extremely valuable.
senses.example_zh: 那封舊信帶有一位著名詩人的簽名，因此極為珍貴。

senses.en: to take responsibility for; to endure
senses.pattern: bear the cost / bear responsibility / can't bear the pain
senses.example: Whoever breaks the lab equipment must [[bear]] the full cost of replacing it.
senses.example_zh: 無論誰弄壞實驗室的設備，都必須承擔全部的更換費用。

senses.en: to produce fruit or flowers; to give birth to
senses.pattern: bear fruit / bear seeds / bear a child
senses.example: The mango tree in our yard did not [[bear]] fruit until its sixth year.
senses.example_zh: 我們院子裡的芒果樹直到第六年才結果。
senses.note: 三態 bear–bore–borne；bear fruit 亦指「有成果」

gsat.sentence: The 10 bells vary in size, each [[bearing]] a name.
It allows redwood trees to [[bear]] seeds.

senses.en: an organized group of people with an official role
senses.pattern: a governing body / the student body / an independent body
senses.example: The student council is the elected [[body]] that speaks for all students at our school.
senses.example_zh: 學生會是代表本校全體學生發言的民選團體。

senses.en: a large amount or mass of something
senses.pattern: a body of evidence / a large body of research / a body of water
senses.example: A large [[body]] of research shows that regular exercise improves both memory and mood.
senses.example_zh: 大量研究顯示，規律運動能同時改善記憶力與情緒。

senses.en: an upper limit on an amount
senses.pattern: a cap on spending / a price cap / put a cap on
senses.example: The school put a [[cap]] of thirty students on each class to keep lessons effective.
senses.example_zh: 學校為每班設下三十名學生的上限，以維持教學成效。

senses.en: to set an upper limit on something
senses.pattern: cap prices / cap the number of / be capped at
senses.example: To protect the island's coral reefs, the number of daily visitors is [[capped]] at five hundred.
senses.example_zh: 為了保護島上的珊瑚礁，每日遊客人數設有五百人的上限。

senses.en: to accuse someone formally of a crime
senses.pattern: charge sb with theft / be charged with murder / charge sb with a crime
senses.example: Police [[charged]] the driver with causing the accident after checking the street cameras.
senses.example_zh: 警方查看路口監視器後，控告該名駕駛肇事。
senses.note: 名詞 charge 也指「罪名、指控」

senses.en: to rush forward, especially to attack
senses.pattern: charge at / charge toward / charge into the room
senses.example: The angry bull lowered its head and [[charged]] at the farmer, who jumped over the fence.
senses.example_zh: 憤怒的公牛低下頭，朝農夫猛衝過去，農夫趕緊跳過籬笆。

gsat.sentence: Then they wanted to put him in jail and [[charged]] him with violation of law for climbing the building without a permit.

senses.en: to go and get something, or receive money owed
senses.pattern: collect a prize / collect taxes / collect the rent / collect a parcel
senses.example: Winners must [[collect]] their prizes at the school office before Friday afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 得獎者必須在星期五下午之前到學校辦公室領取獎品。

senses.en: to bring your thoughts or feelings under control
senses.pattern: collect your thoughts / collect yourself / pause to collect oneself
senses.example: She paused for a moment to [[collect]] her thoughts before answering the interviewer's difficult question.
senses.example_zh: 她停頓片刻整理思緒，才回答面試官的難題。
senses.note: collected (adj.) 鎮定的，如 calm and collected

senses.en: a substance that lets heat or electricity pass through
senses.pattern: a good conductor of heat / a poor conductor / a conductor of electricity
senses.example: Copper is such a good [[conductor]] of electricity that it is used in most household wires.
senses.example_zh: 銅是極佳的電導體，因此大多數家用電線都使用它。

senses.en: a person who checks tickets on a train or bus
senses.pattern: a train conductor / a bus conductor / show the conductor your ticket
senses.example: The [[conductor]] walked through the train, checking every passenger's ticket before the next stop.
senses.example_zh: 列車長走過車廂，在下一站之前查驗每位乘客的車票。

senses.en: the period or way in which something develops
senses.pattern: over the course of / in the course of / run its course / change the course of history
senses.example: In the [[course]] of a single afternoon, the storm flooded half the village.
senses.example_zh: 在短短一個下午的過程中，暴風雨就淹沒了半個村莊。

senses.en: the direction something moves in; a way of acting
senses.pattern: change course / off course / a course of action
senses.example: Strong winds blew the small plane off [[course]], and it landed two hours late.
senses.example_zh: 強風把小飛機吹離航向，結果晚了兩小時才降落。

senses.en: one of the separate parts of a meal
senses.pattern: the main course / a three-course meal / the first course
senses.example: The wedding dinner had eight [[courses]], and the fish was served just before dessert.
senses.example_zh: 那場喜宴共有八道菜，魚就在甜點之前上桌。
senses.note: a course of treatment 指「療程」

gsat.sentence: Over the [[course]] of the morning, the innovative discussion process gave rise to a new form of collective effort that transformed the depth, scope, and quality of their discussion.
Very few people, no matter how intelligent or experienced, can take into account all the possibilities or outcomes of a policy or a [[course]] of action within just a short period of time.

senses.en: to tell officials about taxable goods or income
senses.pattern: declare goods at customs / declare your income / nothing to declare
senses.example: Travelers carrying large amounts of cash must [[declare]] it to customs officers on arrival.
senses.example_zh: 攜帶大量現金的旅客，入境時必須向海關人員申報。

senses.en: relating to the home or family life
senses.pattern: domestic chores / domestic appliances / domestic violence
senses.example: In many families, [[domestic]] chores such as cooking and laundry are now shared by both parents.
senses.example_zh: 在許多家庭裡，煮飯、洗衣等家務現在由父母雙方分擔。

senses.en: (of animals) kept on farms or as pets
senses.pattern: domestic animals / domestic cats / domestic and wild animals
senses.example: Unlike wolves, [[domestic]] dogs have learned to read human gestures and facial expressions.
senses.example_zh: 與狼不同，人類馴養的狗已學會解讀人的手勢和臉部表情。

senses.en: to accept an idea or change willingly
senses.pattern: embrace change / embrace new technology / embrace an idea / embrace the opportunity
senses.example: Older teachers at our school were quick to [[embrace]] the new online grading system.
senses.example_zh: 我們學校的資深老師很快就欣然接受新的線上評分系統。

senses.en: to include something as part of a whole
senses.pattern: embrace a wide range of / embrace many subjects / embrace several fields
senses.example: Her research [[embraces]] a wide range of topics, from ocean pollution to city planning.
senses.example_zh: 她的研究涵蓋廣泛的主題，從海洋汙染到都市規劃都有。

gsat.sentence: In response to rising demands, these hotels are [[embracing]] a wave of innovation. Instead of the traditional bare pod-sized style, new chains now feature interior design that appeals to digitally connected travelers from around the world.
We have completely [[embraced]] paper technology.

senses.en: to offer a welcome, thanks, or an invitation
senses.pattern: extend a warm welcome / extend an invitation / extend our thanks / extend help to
senses.example: On behalf of the school, I would like to [[extend]] a warm welcome to our exchange students.
senses.example_zh: 我謹代表學校，向各位交換學生表達熱烈的歡迎。

senses.en: to include or apply to someone or something
senses.pattern: extend to / extend beyond / extend to all members
senses.example: The ban on plastic straws now [[extends]] to all night markets and food stalls in the city.
senses.example_zh: 塑膠吸管的禁令現在適用於全市所有夜市和小吃攤。

senses.en: to deal with questions or comments
senses.pattern: field questions / field calls / field complaints
senses.example: After the speech, the scientist spent an hour [[fielding]] questions from curious students.
senses.example_zh: 演講結束後，那位科學家花了一小時應對好奇學生的提問。

senses.en: real conditions outside a laboratory or office
senses.pattern: in the field / field research / a field study
senses.example: The biologist spends six months a year in the [[field]], recording the behavior of wild elephants.
senses.example_zh: 這位生物學家每年有六個月在野外實地記錄野生大象的行為。
senses.note: field trip 實地考察、校外教學

senses.en: a very large amount of money
senses.pattern: make a fortune / cost a fortune / a small fortune / inherit a fortune
senses.example: Repairing the old temple roof cost a [[fortune]], so villagers held a fair to raise money.
senses.example_zh: 修繕老廟的屋頂花了一筆巨款，於是村民舉辦園遊會來募款。

senses.en: the good and bad things that happen to someone
senses.pattern: the fortunes of / changing fortunes / a reversal of fortune / tell sb's fortune
senses.example: The team's [[fortunes]] changed overnight when a talented young pitcher joined them in June.
senses.example_zh: 一位有天分的年輕投手在六月加入後，這支球隊的命運一夕之間改變。

gsat.sentence: The movie director adapted this year’s bestseller into a hit and made a [[fortune]].

Cartier-Bresson’s family was wealthy—his father made a [[fortune]] as a textile manufacturer—but Cartier-Bresson later joked that due to his parents’ frugal ways, it often seemed as though his family was poor.

senses.en: to attract someone's attention or interest
senses.pattern: grab sb's attention / grab the headlines / grab the audience
senses.example: A good title should [[grab]] readers' attention and make them want to read on.
senses.example_zh: 好的標題應該吸引讀者的注意，讓他們想繼續讀下去。

senses.en: to quickly get or have food, sleep, or a thing
senses.pattern: grab a bite / grab a coffee / grab some sleep / grab a seat
senses.example: We only had ten minutes between classes, so we [[grabbed]] a sandwich at the school store.
senses.example_zh: 我們課間只有十分鐘，所以在合作社匆匆買了個三明治吃。

gsat.sentence: So, [[grab]] a copy and start learning how you can reduce stress in your life.

senses.en: to make someone very interested or addicted
senses.pattern: be hooked on / get hooked on / hook the reader
senses.example: My brother got [[hooked]] on the detective series after watching just one episode.
senses.example_zh: 我弟弟只看了一集，就對那部偵探影集著迷了。
senses.note: 常用被動 be / get hooked on

senses.en: something designed to catch people's attention
senses.pattern: a catchy hook / an opening hook / a sales hook
senses.example: Every good speech needs a [[hook]] in its first minute to keep the audience listening.
senses.example_zh: 每場好演講都需要在第一分鐘有個吸引人的亮點，才能讓聽眾繼續聽下去。

senses.en: to make clothes smooth with a hot iron
senses.pattern: iron a shirt / iron your uniform / do the ironing
senses.example: He carefully [[ironed]] his white shirt the night before the job interview.
senses.example_zh: 面試前一晚，他仔細地熨燙了他的白襯衫。
senses.note: n. 熨斗；iron out 解決（問題）

senses.en: very strong and determined; very strict
senses.pattern: an iron will / iron discipline / rule with an iron fist
senses.example: It took an [[iron]] will for her to finish the marathon with an injured knee.
senses.example_zh: 她憑著鋼鐵般堅強的意志，才帶著受傷的膝蓋跑完馬拉松。

senses.en: a period of time away from work
senses.pattern: sick leave / maternity leave / on leave / take a week's leave
senses.example: Our math teacher is on maternity [[leave]], so a substitute will teach us until June.
senses.example_zh: 我們的數學老師正在休產假，所以代課老師會教我們到六月。

senses.en: to give something to someone after you die
senses.pattern: leave sth to sb / leave sb a fortune / leave money to charity
senses.example: The childless farmer [[left]] all his land to the village school in his will.
senses.example_zh: 那位沒有子女的農夫在遺囑中把所有土地遺贈給村裡的學校。

senses.en: to cause someone or something to be in a state
senses.pattern: leave sb homeless / leave sth unchecked / be left vacant / leave sb speechless
senses.example: The earthquake [[left]] thousands of families homeless and cut off electricity for a week.
senses.example_zh: 地震使數千個家庭無家可歸，並造成停電一星期。

gsat.sentence: The study warned that Papua’s glaciers are only the “first to go” if greenhouse gases are [[left]] unchecked and temperatures continue rising.
[[Left]] vacant for years, the deserted house was filled with a thick coating of dust and a smell of old damp wood.

senses.en: to work at or operate a place or machine
senses.pattern: man the desk / man the phones / man a booth / a manned spacecraft
senses.example: Student volunteers [[manned]] the information desk all day during the school anniversary fair.
senses.example_zh: 校慶園遊會期間，學生志工整天在服務台值班。
senses.note: manned 有人駕駛的；unmanned 無人的

senses.en: extremely small; very detailed
senses.pattern: minute particles / a minute amount / minute details / in minute detail
senses.example: Even [[minute]] amounts of the chemical in drinking water can harm young children.
senses.example_zh: 飲用水中即使只含微小劑量的這種化學物質，也可能傷害幼兒。

senses.en: the official written record of a meeting
senses.pattern: take the minutes / the minutes of the meeting / approve the minutes
senses.example: As secretary of the science club, Mia takes the [[minutes]] of every meeting and emails them to members.
senses.example_zh: 身為科學社的文書，米亞負責寫每次開會的會議紀錄，再用電子郵件寄給社員。

senses.en: the courage to do something difficult
senses.pattern: have the nerve to / lose your nerve / keep your nerve / it takes nerve to
senses.example: The shy boy finally found the [[nerve]] to sing alone on stage at the talent show.
senses.example_zh: 那個害羞的男孩終於鼓起勇氣，在才藝表演中獨自上台唱歌。
senses.note: have the nerve to 亦指「竟敢、厚臉皮」

senses.en: feelings of worry or anxiety
senses.pattern: calm your nerves / exam nerves / a bundle of nerves / suffer from nerves
senses.example: She took a few deep breaths to calm her [[nerves]] before the piano competition began.
senses.example_zh: 鋼琴比賽開始前，她深呼吸幾次來緩和緊張的情緒。

senses.en: used to explain or give another name
senses.pattern: geology, or the study of rocks / twelve inches, or one foot / or rather
senses.example: Botany, [[or]] the scientific study of plants, has fascinated her since she was a child.
senses.example_zh: 植物學，也就是研究植物的科學，從她小時候就深深吸引著她。

senses.en: otherwise; if not
senses.pattern: Hurry up, or you'll be late / or else / Be careful, or you'll fall
senses.example: Wear a helmet when you ride a scooter, [[or]] you could be seriously hurt in a crash.
senses.example_zh: 騎機車時要戴安全帽，否則發生車禍時可能會受重傷。

senses.en: the person you are married to or live with
senses.pattern: a life partner / a long-term partner / husbands, wives, or partners
senses.example: Employees may bring their husbands, wives, or [[partners]] to the company's year-end dinner.
senses.example_zh: 員工可以帶丈夫、妻子或伴侶參加公司的尾牙。

senses.en: one of the owners of a business
senses.pattern: a business partner / a senior partner / a partner in a law firm
senses.example: After ten years at the law firm, she was finally made a [[partner]] and shared its profits.
senses.example_zh: 在那家法律事務所工作十年後，她終於成為合夥人，並分享利潤。

senses.en: a factory or place producing power
senses.pattern: a power plant / a chemical plant / a car plant / a water treatment plant
senses.example: The town's largest employer is a car [[plant]] that turns out two hundred vehicles a day.
senses.example_zh: 該鎮最大的雇主是一座每天生產兩百輛車的汽車工廠。

senses.en: to hide something somewhere secretly, often to deceive
senses.pattern: plant evidence / plant a hidden camera / plant sth on sb
senses.example: The suspect claimed that someone had [[planted]] the stolen watch in his bag to frame him.
senses.example_zh: 嫌犯聲稱，有人把那支失竊的手錶偷偷放進他的包包裡栽贓他。
senses.note: plant an idea 指「灌輸想法」

gsat.sentence: De Mestral thus began mass-producing Velcro, opening [[plants]] in Europe and eventually into Canada and the United States.
Sea life can get sucked into desalination [[plants]], killing small ocean creatures like baby fish and plankton, upsetting the food chain.

senses.en: to cause a problem or offer an opportunity
senses.pattern: present a problem / present a challenge / present a danger / present an opportunity
senses.example: Heavy fog [[presents]] a serious danger to drivers on mountain roads in winter.
senses.example_zh: 冬天的濃霧對山路上的駕駛人造成嚴重的危險。

senses.en: to give something formally, often at a ceremony
senses.pattern: present an award / present sb with a medal / present a prize to sb
senses.example: The principal [[presented]] each graduate with a certificate and a small potted plant.
senses.example_zh: 校長頒發給每位畢業生一張證書和一盆小盆栽。

gsat.sentence: Some people also visit the cemetery to clean up the family graves and pray for their ancestors. Food offerings are [[presented]] at house altars and temples.

senses.en: to say firmly that something is true
senses.pattern: protest your innocence / protest that … / protest loudly that …
senses.example: The boy [[protested]] that he had never touched the vase, but nobody in the room believed him.
senses.example_zh: 那個男孩堅稱自己從沒碰過花瓶，但房間裡沒有人相信他。
senses.note: 常見於被人懷疑、指責時

senses.en: to accept that something is true, legal, or important
senses.pattern: recognize that … / recognize the need for / be officially recognized / recognize sb's right
senses.example: The company finally [[recognized]] that its long working hours were harming employees' health.
senses.example_zh: 該公司終於承認，過長的工時正在損害員工的健康。

senses.en: to officially praise or reward someone's achievement
senses.pattern: be recognized for / recognize sb's contribution / recognize outstanding service
senses.example: At the ceremony, three nurses were [[recognized]] for their brave service during the flood.
senses.example_zh: 典禮上，三位護理師因在水災期間的英勇服務而受到表揚。

gsat.sentence: It was officially [[recognized]] in Brazil through the effort of Mestre Bimba.
“It is great to see leaders in the fashion industry [[recognizing]] that the animals need their fur more than we do.”

senses.en: profit made from an investment
senses.pattern: a return on investment / a high return / a good return / returns on savings
senses.example: Investors were promised a ten percent [[return]] within a year, which turned out to be a lie.
senses.example_zh: 投資人被承諾一年內有百分之十的收益，結果竟是一場謊言。

senses.en: to do or give something similar in response
senses.pattern: return a favor / return sb's call / return a smile / return the compliment
senses.example: You helped me move last month, so let me [[return]] the favor by fixing your bike.
senses.example_zh: 你上個月幫我搬家，所以讓我幫你修腳踏車來回報你。

senses.en: one of the small thin plates covering a fish or reptile
senses.pattern: fish scales / be covered in scales / scrape off the scales
senses.example: Before cooking the fish, Grandpa scraped off its [[scales]] with the back of a knife.
senses.example_zh: 煮魚之前，爺爺用刀背刮掉魚的鱗片。

senses.en: a device for weighing people or things
senses.pattern: a bathroom scale / kitchen scales / step on the scale / weigh sth on a scale
senses.example: The nurse asked me to step on the [[scale]] so that she could record my weight.
senses.example_zh: 護理師請我站上磅秤，好讓她記錄我的體重。

senses.en: to climb to the top of something high
senses.pattern: scale a wall / scale a cliff / scale a mountain / scale new heights
senses.example: Using only ropes and their bare hands, the climbers [[scaled]] the cliff in under three hours.
senses.example_zh: 登山者只靠繩索和雙手，不到三小時就攀登上那座峭壁。

senses.en: fixed in advance and not changing
senses.pattern: a set time / a set price / a set menu / set rules
senses.example: There is no [[set]] time for dinner in our house; we eat whenever everyone gets home.
senses.example_zh: 我們家沒有固定的晚餐時間，大家都到家了就開飯。

senses.en: to become solid or firm
senses.pattern: leave the jelly to set / wait for the glue to set / the concrete sets / set hard
senses.example: Put the pudding in the fridge for two hours and wait for it to [[set]].
senses.example_zh: 把布丁放進冰箱兩小時，等它凝固。

senses.en: the scenery or place used for a play or film
senses.pattern: on the set / a film set / a stage set / build the set
senses.example: The actors stayed on the [[set]] until midnight to finish shooting the final scene.
senses.example_zh: 演員們在片場待到午夜，才拍完最後一場戲。

senses.en: a female member of a religious order
senses.pattern: Sister Mary / the sisters of the convent / a Catholic sister
senses.example: The [[sisters]] at the convent run a free clinic for poor families in the mountains.
senses.example_zh: 修道院的修女們為山區的貧困家庭開辦免費診所。
senses.note: 作稱呼時大寫，如 Sister Mary

senses.en: belonging to the same group or closely linked
senses.pattern: a sister school / a sister city / a sister company / a sister ship
senses.example: Every summer, our school sends twenty students to its [[sister]] school in Japan for two weeks.
senses.example_zh: 每年夏天，我們學校會派二十名學生到日本的姊妹校交流兩週。

senses.en: to make time or money available for someone
senses.pattern: spare a few minutes / spare the time / spare some change / can't spare
senses.example: Could you [[spare]] ten minutes after class to look at my science fair report?
senses.example_zh: 你下課後可以撥出十分鐘，看看我的科展報告嗎？

senses.en: to not harm someone; to save from something unpleasant
senses.pattern: spare sb's life / spare sb the trouble / be spared from / spare sb's feelings
senses.example: The typhoon destroyed the coastal villages but [[spared]] the capital, where only light rain fell.
senses.example_zh: 颱風摧毀了沿海的村莊，卻放過了首都，那裡只下了小雨。

senses.en: to avoid using or giving effort or money
senses.pattern: spare no effort / spare no expense / no expense was spared
senses.example: The city [[spared]] no expense in building a library that every resident could be proud of.
senses.example_zh: 該市毫不吝惜經費，興建了一座讓每位市民都引以為傲的圖書館。

gsat.sentence: They wrote letters to the tuna companies and supermarkets asking them to find a way to [[spare]] dolphins.
The Ethiopian government has [[spared]] no efforts in promoting running.

senses.en: one of a series of actions to achieve something
senses.pattern: take steps to / a first step toward / a step in the right direction / the next step
senses.example: The hospital has taken [[steps]] to shorten waiting times in its emergency room.
senses.example_zh: 該醫院已採取措施，縮短急診室的候診時間。
senses.note: step in 介入；step down 下台

gsat.sentence: By providing [[steps]] for settling a disagreement.
These methods range from a simple [[step]] like makeup to a drastic one like surgery.

senses.en: a person or animal used in an experiment
senses.pattern: test subjects / human subjects / subjects in the study
senses.example: Each [[subject]] in the sleep study wore a small device that recorded brain activity overnight.
senses.example_zh: 這項睡眠研究中的每位受試者都配戴一個小型裝置，整夜記錄腦部活動。
senses.note: 也指「臣民」，如 the king's subjects

senses.en: likely to be affected by; depending on
senses.pattern: be subject to change / be subject to delays / be subject to approval
senses.example: Ferry times are [[subject]] to change in bad weather, so check the website before leaving.
senses.example_zh: 天候不佳時，渡輪時刻易受影響而變動，所以出發前請先查看網站。

senses.en: to make someone or something experience something unpleasant
senses.pattern: subject sb to / be subjected to criticism / be subjected to tests / be subjected to pressure
senses.example: New helmets are [[subjected]] to dozens of crash tests before they can be sold.
senses.example_zh: 新安全帽在販售前，必須先經歷數十次撞擊測試。

gsat.sentence: Zebrafish, named for their characteristic stripes, have been a popular test [[subject]] for researchers.
When [[subjected]] to repeated pressurization high in the sky, the four corners on a square window may spell disaster.

senses.en: formal discussions between groups or governments
senses.pattern: peace talks / trade talks / hold talks with / talks break down
senses.example: Pay [[talks]] between the airline and its pilots broke down after only two days.
senses.example_zh: 航空公司與機師之間的薪資談判才進行兩天就破裂了。

senses.en: a speech or informal lecture on a subject
senses.pattern: give a talk on / attend a talk / a talk about
senses.example: A retired astronaut will give a [[talk]] on life in space at our school next Friday.
senses.example_zh: 一位退休太空人下週五將到我們學校演講，談太空中的生活。

gsat.sentence: Clunes, in Australia, holds a monthly book [[talk]] that hosts authors to discuss their latest releases.

senses.en: to be higher than; to be first in
senses.pattern: top the list / top the charts / top one million / top the rankings
senses.example: Ticket sales for the school musical [[topped]] two thousand, breaking last year's record.
senses.example_zh: 學校音樂劇的售票數超過兩千張，打破去年的紀錄。

senses.en: to put something on the top of something
senses.pattern: be topped with cheese / top the cake with fruit / be topped by a tower
senses.example: The shaved ice was [[topped]] with fresh mango and a spoonful of condensed milk.
senses.example_zh: 那碗剉冰上面加了新鮮芒果和一匙煉乳。

senses.en: a piece of clothing for the upper body
senses.pattern: a sleeveless top / a matching top / a pajama top
senses.example: She wore a bright yellow [[top]] with jeans to the class reunion last weekend.
senses.example_zh: 她上週末穿著亮黃色上衣搭配牛仔褲去參加同學會。

gsat.sentence: Cats, dogs, and other pets [[top]] the list, followed by zoo animals.
On the front apron, there is often a kilt pin, [[topped]] with a small decorative family symbol.

senses.en: in the process of; being affected by
senses.pattern: under construction / under discussion / under investigation / under pressure
senses.example: The new metro line is still [[under]] construction and will not open until next spring.
senses.example_zh: 新的捷運線仍在興建中，要到明年春天才會通車。

senses.en: according to a law, rule, or agreement
senses.pattern: under the law / under the new rules / under the terms of / under the agreement
senses.example: [[Under]] the new rules, students may not use their phones during class without permission.
senses.example_zh: 根據新規定，學生未經許可不得在上課時使用手機。

senses.en: led, ruled, or managed by someone
senses.pattern: under the leadership of / under the guidance of / under the rule of / under new management
senses.example: The choir improved quickly [[under]] the guidance of a conductor who had trained in Vienna.
senses.example_zh: 在一位曾於維也納受訓的指揮指導下，合唱團進步神速。

gsat.sentence: When watching a frightening film, people are in the comfort of their own home or theater seats rather than [[under]] the threat of any real danger.
[[Under]] the guidance of 100% Fish, however, Icelanders are now using almost 95% of a cod.

senses.en: to move along by turning and changing direction
senses.pattern: weave through traffic / weave in and out of / weave your way through
senses.example: The delivery rider [[weaved]] through the heavy traffic to get the meals there on time.
senses.example_zh: 外送員在擁擠的車陣中迂迴穿行，好把餐點準時送達。

senses.en: to put facts or events together into a story
senses.pattern: weave a story / weave a tale / weave sth into the plot
senses.example: The novelist [[wove]] a moving story from the letters her grandparents wrote during the war.
senses.example_zh: 這位小說家用祖父母在戰時寫的信，編寫出一個動人的故事。

quiz.stem: At the press conference after the game, the coach patiently ______ questions from reporters about why the team had lost so badly.
quiz.explain_zh: field＝應對（提問）。教練在賽後記者會上耐心回答記者的提問。

quiz.stem: The sports association is the governing ______ that sets the rules for all high school basketball tournaments in the country.
quiz.explain_zh: body＝團體、機構。該運動協會是制定全國高中籃球賽規則的管理機構。

quiz.stem: Under a powerful microscope, even ______ cracks in the metal, far too small to be seen with the naked eye, become clearly visible.
quiz.explain_zh: minute＝微小的。在高倍顯微鏡下，肉眼看不見的微小裂縫也清晰可見。

quiz.stem: Because of a serious knee injury, the firefighter was given three months of sick ______ to rest and recover at home.
quiz.explain_zh: leave＝休假。消防員因膝蓋受傷，獲准請三個月病假在家休養。

quiz.stem: Thanks to an early warning sent to every phone, most residents escaped in time and were ______ the worst effects of the flood.
quiz.explain_zh: spare＝使免於。居民因預警及時逃離，免於洪水最嚴重的衝擊。

quiz.stem: Residents complained that smoke from the chemical ______ near the river was polluting the air and making their children cough.
quiz.explain_zh: plant＝工廠。居民抱怨河邊化工廠排出的煙汙染空氣。

quiz.stem: While some elderly villagers still prefer cash, most young shop owners have eagerly ______ mobile payment as a faster way to do business.
quiz.explain_zh: embrace＝欣然接受。年輕店主樂於採用行動支付來做生意。

quiz.stem: It takes a lot of ______ to stand up in front of the whole school and admit that you made a serious mistake.
quiz.explain_zh: nerve＝勇氣、膽量。在全校面前承認自己犯了大錯，需要很大的勇氣。

quiz.stem: The cause of the factory fire is still ______ investigation, and the police have not yet said when the results will be announced.
quiz.explain_zh: under＝在…（進行）中。工廠火災的起因仍在調查中，警方尚未公布結果。

quiz.stem: Every bottle of this olive oil ______ a label showing where and when the olives were harvested.
quiz.explain_zh: bear＝帶有。每瓶橄欖油都帶有標示橄欖採收地點與時間的標籤。
